identity.title: The Power of One: The Pokémon 2000 Movie Special

leadText:
The Power Of One: The Pokémon 2000 Movie Special was a television special that aired on network in the on July 16, 2000 . The TV special was created to promote the theatrical English dub release of the second Pokémon movie, Pokémon the Movie 2000: The Power of One. The WB was the American home of at the time, owned by Warner Bros., who was also distributing the film. The special was hosted by actor and comedian , and was directed by Richard Brian DiPirro .

The special featured live performances of songs from the movie's soundtrack and included segments that went behind-the-scenes on how the soundtrack's music was produced, with interviews of artists whose music was featured. Guest appearances included , , , and , all of whom told inspirational stories centered around the theme of "the power of one".

The special only aired once and never saw commercial release on home media. The DVD release of Pokémon the Movie 2000: The Power of One contained segments from the special as bonus features.
